name: SoFiE sponsored joint Financial Econometrics Conference (FINEC2027)
organizer: Lancaster University Management School (EMP Centre, Department of Accounting and Finance, Department of Economics); sponsored by SoFiE
deadline_note: Stated as "Closing Date for Paper Submission: 1st December 2026"
